title: Couch - launch health
description: How well is the one job working? Time-to-READY is the number the whole system is judged on - the guide measured 6-8s warm and 8-13s from sleep ONCE, by hand. This makes it a distribution you can watch drift.

panels.title: Failures (7d)
panels.description: launch_failed means the TV input was never switched - the one rule held.

panels.title: Median time to READY
panels.description: dur_ms on host_ready, measured from the chord or the wake word - not from when Enter started. This is what the couch actually experiences.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.5, {service="k15", lane="launch", env="prod"} | json | event="host_ready" | unwrap dur_ms [7d])

panels.title: p95 time to READY
panels.description: The bad night. A warm enter is ~6-8s; wake-from-sleep 8-13s. If p95 climbs past that, something is degrading.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service="k15", lane="launch", env="prod"} | json | event="host_ready" | unwrap dur_ms [7d])

panels.title: Time to READY, per launch
panels.description: Points, not an average - with a handful of launches a day the individual values ARE the signal, and an average would hide the one that took 40 seconds.

targets.expr: max_over_time({service="k15", lane="launch", env="prod"} | json | event="host_ready" | unwrap dur_ms [$__auto])

panels.title: Milestones within a launch
panels.description: ssh_up is the PC waking; enter_dispatched is sshd answering; host_ready is Enter finishing. Which line moved tells you WHICH stage got slower.

targets.expr: max_over_time({service="k15", lane="launch", env="prod"} | json | event="ssh_up" | unwrap dur_ms [$__auto])
max_over_time({service="k15", lane="launch", env="prod"} | json | event="enter_dispatched" | unwrap dur_ms [$__auto])
max_over_time({service="k15", lane="launch", env="prod"} | json | event="host_ready" | unwrap dur_ms [$__auto])

panels.title: Recent launches, end to end
panels.description: Both machines. Once E4 ships the gaming PC, a single launch's K15 and PC lines interleave here by turn.
